title: Depot WAN instability on Leeds and Bristol links
description: Both depots drop packets in bursts during the working day; users see Teams and WMS failures.
root_cause: Provider reports CRC errors on the local loop at both sites. Suspect shared upstream card.
workaround: Failover to 4G bonded router during an outage; performance is degraded but usable.

title: Outlook credential prompts after MFA policy change
description: Recurring password prompts across ~30 users since the conditional access change.
root_cause: Modern auth disabled on a legacy connector still in the policy set.
workaround: Clear cached credentials and re-register the device.

title: Sage 200 report timeouts at month end
description: Finance reports time out between the 28th and the 2nd every month.
root_cause: Missing index on the posting table; the plan flips to a scan once the table passes ~4m rows.
workaround: Run the heavy reports out of hours until the index ships.

title: Warehouse scanners lose WMS session over wifi roam
description: Scanners drop the WMS session when roaming between aisles.
root_cause: AP firmware does not honour the fast-roam setting; vendor bug ref WX-4471.
workaround: Pin the affected aisles to a single AP channel until firmware 9.4 is released.

title: Backup job fails when a snapshot is left mounted
description: Nightly SQL backup fails roughly one night in ten.
root_cause: A failed snapshot is not cleaned up, so the next run cannot acquire the volume.
workaround: Dismount the stale snapshot and re-run the job.

title: MFD firmware 3.18 breaks Windows print queues
description: After the vendor firmware push, queues fail with 0x0000011b.
root_cause: Firmware changed the IPP negotiation; the queue must be recreated as IPP rather than RAW.

title: Guest wifi DHCP pool exhaustion
description: Guests intermittently fail to get an address on busy days.
root_cause: Lease time of 24 hours on a /24 pool; visitor churn exhausts it.

title: Air-con short-cycling in HQ comms room
description: Temperature alarms during warm afternoons; the unit short-cycles rather than holding setpoint.
root_cause: Suspected refrigerant loss - Marlbrook engineer booked.
workaround: Portable unit plus propped door with a monitored temperature probe.

title: Site Access Control readers freeze after power blip
description: Readers need a manual power cycle after any brief mains interruption.
root_cause: Unknown - controller may lack a watchdog.

title: SharePoint sync errors on long file paths
description: Sync stalls on paths over 255 characters, mostly in the tender library.
root_cause: Known Microsoft limitation with the legacy sync client.
workaround: Shorten folder names or map the library as a drive.

title: VPN drops on 4G with aggressive NAT timeouts
description: Site cabins lose the tunnel every few minutes on one carrier.
root_cause: Carrier NAT timeout is shorter than the tunnel keepalive.
workaround: Reduce the keepalive interval to 20 seconds on affected profiles.

title: File server growth outpacing capacity plan
root_cause: No quota policy on the shared drives; media files never archived.
workaround: Emergency clean-up of the recycle bins and old ISO images.
